name: Yen Carry Unwind — August 2024
description: The Bank of Japan's surprise rate hike on July 31 triggered a violent unwind of yen-funded carry trades, sending VIX to 65 intraday on August 5 before a sharp reversal over the following weeks. Equities sold off broadly with tech and small-caps hit hardest, then rallied back, rewarding agents that sized down into the spike and re-entered at cheaper levels. The episode tests risk management under an extreme but short-lived vol regime with fast mean-reversion.
